title: Lease due-at-signing excludes first month payment from total
quote: Requires $4059 due at signing plus first payment
statute: CA Vehicle Code §11713.16; Reg M 12 CFR 1013.4
recommendation: The lease disclaimers state '$4059 due at signing plus first payment' and '$3989 due at signing plus first payment,' which separates the first month payment from the due-at-signing total. Revise the disclaimers to state the complete due-at-signing amount including first month payment.
